data.one_liner: A vector graphics rendering package for Flutter using a binary encoding.
data.what_it_does: A vector graphics rendering runtime for Flutter designed to work with compiled binary vector graphic assets. It renders vector graphics efficiently using a binary encoding format.
use_when: You need to render pre-compiled vector graphics in a Flutter application.
You want optimized vector graphics rendering performance using a binary format.
avoid_when: You are using raw SVG files without compiling them first via vector_graphics_compiler.
strengths: Efficient binary encoding format for vector graphics
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Requires pre-compiling vector graphics using a separate compiler package

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows rendering raw SVG files directly without needing a separate compilation step.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general raster image manipulation and loading instead of vector graphics.
